title: Deterministic time hierarchy
statement: Let $f,g:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and suppose $g$ is time constructible. Suppose also that for every $A\in\mathbb{N}$ there is an $N\in\mathbb{N}$ such that for every $n\ge N$, $A(f(n)+n+1)^2\le g(n)$. Then $\mathrm{DTIME}(f)$ is a proper subset of $\mathrm{DTIME}(n\mapsto g(n)+1)$.
